name: Honey Pork Noodles
method: Heat the grill to high. Mix the honey, soy sauce, five spice, paprika and oil in a bowl and turn the sliced pork in it.
Lay the pork on a foil-lined tray and pour the leftover marinade into a small pan. Grill the pork for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until lightly charred and cooked through.
Boil the spare marinade for about 3 minutes until thick and glossy and spoon it over the pork.
Boil the noodles for 3 minutes, adding the stir-fry vegetables for the last 2, then drain and serve with the pork.
